event: Fri 27 Nov: US half-day, thin trade. Sun 29 Nov: OPEC+ meeting. Fri 4 Dec: US jobs report (15:30 SAST, UNVERIFIED). Fed decision Wed 9 Dec, 21:00 SAST, with a hike widely expected.

bullets.title: Bounce is stalling
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 3,571 at 16:00 SAST, down 0.3% on the day, after failing to hold a push toward 3,600 (Brisk Markets, citing Reuters).

bullets.title: Wednesday's low
bullets.text: Gold hit about 3,446 on Wednesday after hot PCE data, its lowest since August 2025, then bounced (Brisk Markets); some reports put the low nearer 3,426, so the exact low is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Hike fully priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 94-96% odds of a 0.25% Fed hike on 9 December, which keeps the bigger trend down (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Yields eased slightly
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield slipped toward 4.84%, which gave gold some room to bounce (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Tariffs and Middle East
bullets.text: New US tariff proposals on China and other partners and Middle East tension give limited safe-haven support (GoodReturns, Brisk Markets).

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: US markets were shut today and reopen for a half-day on Friday, so moves can be jumpy and breakouts less reliable.
